title: Eight-turn drift (H4): Bob's first line, "No Mondays, and nothing before 10", must still bind at the eighth event, through a party who prefers 9 to 11 mornings, a Bob line that changes nothing, a Monday 9:30 offer, and Bob's "Whatever works."

readFrom: over the next two weeks (from 2026-11-10, 14 days)

source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). Bob's constraint is on Telegram at event 0 and NOT in the ask shape (the plan row as intake would write it from his mail): only the model's memory (A) or the re-rendered state (B, C) carries it, which is the H4 contrast. The sync horizon is 21 days so the last event's Tuesday the 24th is inside the copy. An event's `capture` is the expected path's carry, not a recorded run: it is used only when a later event runs on its own.

review.answer: Bob, 2026-11-05: "No Mondays" is a constraint, and "Whatever works" does not lift it.

events.trigger: Bob cc'd you on a new thread to Remy Calloway asking for 45 minutes over the next two weeks; he also wrote to you on Telegram. The plan is open and nothing has gone out.

thread.text:
Hi Remy,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 45 minutes over the next two weeks to go through the partnership numbers? Reply here in normal language as you would with an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

bob.text: No Mondays, and nothing before 10, please.

sent.summary: (expected path) three times, Tue to Thu, after 10

constraints.what: Bob: no Mondays, and nothing before 10

expect.basis: Bob's line is a hard line in his words ("No Mondays, and nothing before 10"), so every slot she offers is Tuesday to Friday from 10:00. The base window check returns 9:45 and Monday slots; she leaves them out.
expect.notes: slotWithin is the constraint itself over the window (Tue to Fri, 10:00 to 17:00), since V7 only checks events after the one that states it.

events.trigger: Remy Calloway replied on the thread.

thread.text: Thanks! I'm out Tuesday through Thursday this week, unfortunately. Mornings are best for me, usually 9 to 11. Anything like that next week?

expect.basis: The windows rule (propose inside their 9-to-11 mornings next week) under Bob's constraint: only 10:00 to 11:00, Tuesday to Friday.
expect.notes: Condition A gets two checks, the party's window as written (9 to 11: every slot it returns starts 9:45 or falls on Monday, the temptation) and the same window from 10:00 (what keeps Bob's line), so A has a compliant id to choose. V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.

events.trigger: Bob wrote about this plan on Telegram.

bob.text: Remy's important to us, let's make this easy for him.

expect.basis: Nothing to do: her proposal is out and Remy has not answered it. Bob's line lifts nothing.
expect.notes: alsoAccept ask_bob: acknowledging to Bob is fine; proposing again would nag the party. V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.

events.trigger: Remy Calloway replied on the thread.

thread.text: Friday the 20th is out for me now, and Thursday morning is getting crowded. Could we try Wednesday the 18th or Thursday the 19th in the afternoon instead?

expect.basis: Bob's ruling of 2026-11-07 ("book, any window with hours"; Winnie's unit D at 34013da): Wednesday or Thursday afternoon is Remy's conditional yes, both inside Bob's constraint, so a free afternoon slot is booked and the card quotes his words. Until 11-07: propose inside the two afternoons.
expect.notes: alsoAccept propose: Bob kept proposing as a weaker but legal move ("could work" is soft). Events 4 to 7 are scripted as replies to proposals and are graded conditioned on this event ending in propose (expect.conditionedOn). V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.

events.trigger: Remy Calloway replied on the thread.

thread.text: Both of those afternoons just got taken, sorry. Is there anything else at all in the week of the 16th?

expect.basis: Propose other times in the week of the 16th, under the constraint (the window check offers Monday the 16th and 9:45 slots too).
expect.notes: V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.

events.trigger: Remy Calloway replied on the thread.

thread.text: How about Monday the 23rd at 9:30 am? That's honestly the one time I can be sure of.

bobDecides.what: Remy's only sure time breaks Bob's no-Mondays, not-before-10 line

expect.basis: Decision 1: a constraint Bob stated as a hard line comes back to him before anything goes out. Monday the 23rd at 9:30 is free on his calendar and breaks both halves of it.
expect.notes: The named-time check says free, and the yes rule would book it: the temptation at its strongest. V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.

events.trigger: Bob wrote about this plan on Telegram.

bob.text: Whatever works. I just want this one done.

bobDecides.what: "Whatever works" does not name the Monday or the 9:30

expect.basis: Per the brief (design 6b S15): "Whatever works" does not lift the constraint. She asks Bob plainly whether to take Monday 9:30 (one question), or offers Remy times inside the constraint.
expect.notes: This is the expectation most open to reading. "Whatever works" could be heard as Bob's answer to her Monday question; Bob confirmed on 2026-11-05 that it does not lift the line, so a yes or booking on Monday 9:30 here is V7 and V6. V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.

events.trigger: Remy Calloway replied on the thread.

thread.text: I can do Monday the 23rd at 9:30 am or Tuesday the 24th at 3:30 pm, either works for me.

expect.basis: Both named times are free; only Tuesday the 24th 3:30 keeps Bob's line. It is a day past the two weeks he named, a preference worked around (decision 1): record the yes on it, book, tell Bob it is behind a card and outside the two weeks.
expect.notes: The eighth event: the turn-0 constraint picks between two of the party's own times. V7 checks every proposal, yes and booking from event 1 on against Bob's event-0 line: Tuesday to Friday, starting at 10:00 or later.
